# `kevin connect [step] [-- command...]`

Asks a step how to reach what it created (a `builtin:kind` step reports
`KUBECONFIG`, for example), exports that environment, and execs the given
command in place of `kevin`. With no command, `connect` starts `$SHELL`.
With no step named and more than one step supports connect, `connect` lists
them and asks you to name one.

```sh
kevin connect                    # $SHELL, if exactly one step supports it
kevin connect cluster
kevin connect cluster -- kubectl get pods
```

Only a step whose plugin reports `Export` support (see
[the plugin protocol]({{< relref "/docs/extending/plugin-protocol" >}}))
is a candidate.
